digest.component_or_area: CI lint enforcement for raw git write operations
propositions: Raw git mutations (add/commit/rm/mv/reset/update-ref/checkout/clean) bypass canonical locked store write seams when used outside sanctioned modules, causing production bugs like 3435, 3a33, 4dd2, 4c6c.

Only two sanctioned write seams exist: (1) store seam internals (gitutil.run_git/run_git_write, event_append._run_git, txn.py, purge_bridge.py), and (2) reconciler seam (git_adapter.py, _ref_lock.py); all other raw git writes are bypasses.

A module-agnostic deterministic CI lint must flag raw git mutations in Python via AST intra-function argv tracking (local list literals, local variables, and opaque argv) and in workflows via cwd-aware context detection (cd/.tickets-tracker or git -C paths).
Sanction requires an inline marker '# raw-git-ok: <reason>' with mandatory reason; marker-without-reason and unmarked mutations must fail CI.

Report-mode bootstrap must enumerate all current raw git hits (seam internals, maintenance callers, disposable-workspace sites) and remediate or mark each with a reasoned marker before enforcement mode is activated.
